Definition: adverb from G514; appropriately:--as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily(-thy).
BiblicalUsage: This is the adverb form — walk worthily. Paul begs the Ephesians to walk worthy of the calling they received, and tells the Philippians to let their manner of life be worthy of the gospel of Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a calling is not just believed but walked, and the walk should match the gospel it belongs to.
